rav-yosef-brei-derav-sala-chasida.name: Rav Yosef, son of Rav Sala Ḥasida
rav-yosef-brei-derav-sala-chasida.he: רב יוסף בריה דרב סלא חסידא
rav-yosef-brei-derav-sala-chasida.bio: Babylonian Amora who explains a baraita before Rav Pappa (Arakhin 33b); his father is remembered as Rav Sala the Pious.
rav-yosef-brei-derav-sala-chasida.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark, neatly kept beard and a plain undyed wool mantle, a modest and earnest expression as he explains a teaching to his master; background of mudbrick academy walls lit by oil lamps.
